title: JANUS Engine — Howl's Moving Castle RUN-006 full integrated ignition screen
scope_boundary: This is a numerical integrated launch using current literature/model anchors. It is not a physical hardware startup and does not replace the open measurement gates.

frozen_architecture.water_side: 21.2109 m2 sectorized annular flat POMS crown
frozen_architecture.optional_magnetics: micro-EPM assist not credited until bench A/B proves lower total Wh
frozen_architecture.battery: dual independently managed packs through bidirectional DC/DC stages
frozen_architecture.scale_control: low-hardness initial water + low-adhesion wall + rotating Axle/wiper + crystal trap
frozen_architecture.energy_source_boundary: PEMFC requires explicit external hydrogen fuel; oxygen extracted by the gill is oxidizer, not primary energy

run_schedule.note: 12/10/8 W are explicit screening envelopes, not measured JANUS loads. No unmeasured hydraulic regeneration is credited.

selected_nominal_case.reason: RUN005 high break-even target inside the currently selected 0.064-0.13 first-demonstrator band
selected_nominal_case.fuel_caution: This H2 number is stoichiometric reactant only; practical PEMFC feed/purge/excess and fuel-system auxiliaries remain hardware measurements. Hydrogen remains the external chemical-energy source.

magnetic_and_hydraulic_accounting.reason: No independent mechanical source is numerically proven in this integrated run, so generator recovery from the Axle is not credited.
magnetic_and_hydraulic_accounting.external_flow_sensitivity: R0A4D shows external-flow torque can reduce AFPM support or enter regeneration, but it must be measured with flow/head/drag and AFPM efficiency before being added.
magnetic_and_hydraulic_accounting.micro_EPM: not credited; switching-only power can be low in prior screens but assist torque is unmeasured

scale_and_maintenance_accounting.crystal_trap: enabled architecturally but no assumed eta_trap is converted into an energy credit
scale_and_maintenance_accounting.Axle_wiper: enabled architecturally; no measured wear/torque penalty available
scale_and_maintenance_accounting.limitation: purge gas mass, valve work, crystal-trap DeltaP, Axle cleaning torque and chemistry effects remain open measured parasitics and therefore are not hidden inside a claim of hardware proof

main_result.best_current_region: At 21.2109 m2 POMS and 8 W steady auxiliary screen, the model becomes battery-neutral during the 6 h run at >=0.100 mg/m2/s if PEMFC conversion reaches the 55% design case.
main_result.conservative_region: Using the small-prototype empirical electrical conversion, the nominal 0.130 mg/m2/s case has positive steady power but requires about 16.49 h total runtime in this startup envelope to repay battery/converter startup losses; 0.160-0.1707 recover in about 9.34-8.28 h.
main_result.dominant_uncertainty: The result is controlled more by actual PEMFC conversion + total auxiliary watts + startup trajectory than by battery count. Two batteries improve control/headroom but not the thermodynamic balance.

next_gate: RUN007_MEASURED_PARASITIC_REPLACEMENT: replace the 12/10/8 W screening schedule with measured water pump, gas loop, AFPM, purge, crystal-trap, controls and thermal-management watts; replace assumed conversion with measured PEMFC efficiency and measured POMS flux.
